name: Tammy Bruce
current_role: Deputy U.S. Representative to the United Nations (since 2026)
summary: Tammy Bruce, a former Fox News host and commentator, was the State Department’s spokesperson from January 2025 until spring 2026, when she moved to the U.S. mission to the U.N. as deputy representative and Tommy Pigott succeeded her.
